# CAP006 cap-grant-exceeds-ceiling

A `may` grant exceeds a trust-level capability ceiling.

## What it does

Fires per `may` clause on a node whose declared trust is at or below the level of a `ceiling LEVEL forbids ATOM, ...;` item when the granted atom is, covers or lies under a forbidden atom (`fs` covers `fs.write`; aliases are canonical). The message names the ceiling. Nodes without a trust level are not judged.

## Why it matters

Node trust (`foreign < authenticated < trusted`) otherwise never reaches capability evaluation, so a foreign node could be granted `process.spawn` unchallenged.

## Remedy

Remove the grant, raise the node's trust, or relax the ceiling in a reviewed change.

## Examples

### Fires case 1

```grmb expect=fire file=design/m.grmb
grimble = "2";
module m;

ceiling foreign forbids process.spawn, fs.write;

node a : foreign {
  owns "src/**";
  may process.spawn at "src/**";
}
```

### Clean case 2

```grmb expect=clean file=design/m.grmb
grimble = "2";
module m;

ceiling foreign forbids process.spawn, fs.write;

node a : foreign {
  owns "src/**";
  may fs.read at "src/**";
}
node b : trusted {
  owns "tools/**";
  may process.spawn at "tools/**";
}
```
